chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muyassar, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I cursed five, and every answered Prophet [cursed them too]: The one who adds to the Book of Allah, and the one who abandons my Sunnah, and the one who denies the Divine Decree of Allah, and the one who legalizes for himself from my offspring what Allah has prohibited, and the one who appropriates the Fay' [booty/khums] for himself.'

key_terms.الزَّائِدُ: The one who adds (to the Quran)
key_terms.الْمُسْتَأْثِرُ: The one who appropriates/exclusively takes for himself
key_terms.بِقَدَرِ اللَّهِ: With the Divine Decree/Ordainment of Allah

ai.seo_question: What are the five groups cursed by the Prophet according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith identifies five foundational causes of disbelief, emphasizing the Prophet's authority to curse those who distort divine revelation or neglect his Sunnah. Notably, it highlights the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt by specifying the misappropriation of wealth or legalization of forbidden acts specifically within their lineage, linking theological error to practical injustice. This enumeration serves as a cornerstone for understanding the origins of deviation in Shia scholarship.
